purpose: Teach: 南東/電電/ヴォーカル/長調/小麦粉/エッセー/豪快/マーカー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お住まいが南東向きで日当たり良いって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer was saying her place faces southeast — apparently the light is wonderful all day.
lines.style: Soft unhurried opening on the name, warm hush, savoring the detail like a shared secret.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、電電公社時代の話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, he told me all about his days at the old public telephone corporation.
lines.style: Gentle fond lift on the opening, easy pace, a smile clearly audible behind the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バンドのヴォーカルを担当されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And apparently she sings — she's the vocalist in a band, can you believe it?
lines.style: Small delighted rise on the reveal, hushed café volume, eyebrows raised into the phrasing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、長調、つまり長調のメロディがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She told me she loves major-key melodies — the bright, cheerful ones.
lines.style: Warm and melodic, slowing to relish the word bright, ending on a soft smile.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お菓子作りに使う小麦粉に拘ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently he's very particular about the flour he uses for his baking.
lines.style: Amused admiration, light emphasis on particular, unhurried pace with a gentle head-tilt quality.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エッセー、つまりエッセー集を出版されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And get this — she's actually published a collection of essays.
lines.style: Quiet impressed emphasis, leaning in on the reveal, pace lifting slightly with genuine admiration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、豪快な笑い声で店内が和むよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That big, booming laugh of his — it puts the whole café at ease.
lines.style: Wry warmth, a small laugh caught in the first words, settling into soft affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メニュー作りに蛍光マーカーをご使用だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she was using highlighter markers to plan out a menu, of all things.
lines.style: Soft amused closing cadence, gentle stress on markers, trailing into a contented little hum.
